crs_description: World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS 84), coordinate ordering [latitude, longitude] in Leaflet array structures; [longitude, latitude] in standard GeoJSON

kanaighat_gauge.name: Kanaighat Gauge Station (BWDB SW266 / Model SW108)
kanaighat_gauge.name_bn: কানাইঘাট গেজ স্টেশন (বাপাউবো SW২৬৬ / মডেল SW১০৮)
kanaighat_gauge.role: Primary ground truth validation station for 4-reach Muskingum-Cunge model and 22.5h lead time warning.
kanaighat_gauge.datum: PWD (Public Works Department datum: 13.20m PWD = 12.75m MSL/SOB via +0.45m datum shift)
kanaighat_gauge.source: BWDB & FFWC Hydrological Station Directory (Catalog: SW266)
kanaighat_gauge.reconciliation_note: Official BWDB/FFWC station code for Surma at Kanaighat is SW266. SW108 is the legacy pipeline code in this repository, retained as an alias for internal model compatibility. Official BWDB SW108 in national catalog is Chardoani tidal station in Barguna.

surma_river.role: Primary hydrologic routing channel parameterized by NASA SWOT RiverSP 2.0 (widths, slope2) and calibrated Manning n in [0.025, 0.10].
surma_river.source: SWORD v16 / NASA SWOT L2 HR RiverSP 2.0 / OpenStreetMap Waterways

kushiyara_river.role: Contextual drainage distributary of the Barak River. Parameterized in SWORD v16 for regional hydraulic representation, but not part of the active 22.5h Surma routing model.
kushiyara_river.source: SWORD v16 / NASA SWOT L2 HR RiverSP 2.0 / OpenStreetMap Waterways

meghalaya_catchment.name: Meghalaya Upstream Catchment (Upper Surma Drainage)
meghalaya_catchment.role: Source area for extreme convective pre-monsoon precipitation, supplying tributary runoff that reaches Kanaighat in ~22.5 to 25.9 hours.
meghalaya_catchment.source: HydroSHEDS v1.0 Catchment Delineation & NASA GPM IMERG Early Run V07B
meghalaya_catchment.precipitation_data: NASA GPM IMERG Early Run 30-min calibrated precipitation
meghalaya_catchment.footprint_note: HydroSHEDS polygon represents physical drainage boundary; 23.5-26.0°N, 91.0-93.5°E is satellite data subset bounding box.
